reviewContext.userProblem: The owner asked (translated): 'Self-review the UI and the features. Are we providing the same usability and functionality as Sentry? If not, improve it.' The committed self-review found 7 defects (B1-B7) and a 60-item Sentry gap table; the adopted scope is S0-S10.

Wave 2: p04 (B2, B3, B5, S1, S2: query language, period, trend, sorts, counts, saved views, item serializer), p05 (S4 archive/escalating with safety rules 1-5, priority, For review, group helpers, ingest hooks), p09 (S7 settings, member delivery, tester, outbound guard, weekly report) and p13 (B3, B4, B5 UI and the stream) implemented per design; every new route declares exactly one permission.
Raw sample values never reach rows, logs, responses or payloads on the new surfaces (saved views, archive state, notification settings, weekly report); the full v13 leak matrix is v13-p17 (run 3).

Masking contract: raw detected values are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; user text passes Redactor; errors never echo the query.

designDecisionsAndRationale: D1 (design-v1-3-sentry-parity.md section 1): is:unresolved and the Unresolved tab mean the open set (unresolved, acknowledged, in_progress, regressed, escalating); status:<value> is exact. Fixes B3 while internal OPEN_STATUSES keeps reconciliation coverage.

D2/D3/D4: archived and escalating are new IssueStatus values; every archive is bounded by archived_at + 90 days and returns as unresolved; ignored stays the approved-exception state only, so archive never becomes permanent suppression.
D5/D6: priority is a triage field derived from severity until set manually; needs_review drives the For review tab and is cleared by any human triage action.

D7/D8: the stream stays on SQL through a pure server-side parser (telescreen.issues.query) for exact counts and keyset paging over masked columns; period defaults to all and custom spans are capped at 365 days.
D10: saved views are server rows whose name and query pass Redactor; a hit returns 422 raw_value_detected and stores nothing.
D16: actor_ref resolves to a display name through the ActorDirectory port, so raw member ids never reach the UI (B4/B6).

D22/D23/D24: per-user notification settings per category; sla_escalated is never filtered; personal Slack goes to members.slack_user_id while slack_channel recipients stay channel-only; the weekly report reuses the owner-digest cron pattern and an editable template.

Section 15 (session 12 revision): run 1 keeps the session-11 scope and waves; each wave-2 plan owns every shared test its change breaks, and cross-wave handovers (screenshots.ts p03 -> p13; issues_* routers and templates p01 -> p04/p05/p09) are serial by wave.
supportedEdgeCases: p04: is:unresolved returns regressed, acknowledged, in_progress and escalating issues; unknown query keys return 422 with token_index and reason and never echo the query; a period span over 365 days or start after end returns VALIDATION_ERROR; cursors carry the sort tuple and id, and a malformed cursor returns VALIDATION_ERROR; a sample secret in a saved-view name returns 422 with no row; the 51st personal view returns 422 limit_exceeded.

p05: PATCH with status archived, escalating, resolved or ignored returns 422 invalid_transition (dedicated endpoints only); archive conditions are bounded by 90 days and out-of-range values return VALIDATION_ERROR; widened exposure on an archived issue escalates it.
p09: a stored slack setting for a member without a Slack id returns 422 recipient_unreachable; an unbound token returns 403; sla_escalated bypasses settings; weekly-report cron empty disables it.

p13: stream tabs, counts, period picker, trend and Values columns render against p03 mock handlers; the default view sends query=is:unresolved and shows a regressed issue (B3); an assignee cell renders a display name and initials, never a raw member id (B4); a negated token such as !source:slack is sent unchanged (B5).
tests/issues/test_issues.py:667 (status=unresolved) keeps passing under the B3 superset semantics.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Bulk actions, merge and unmerge preconditions (D11-D13): v13-p06, run 2.
Issue detail event navigation, tag aggregation, comments edit and delete, mentions, subscriptions and external issue links (D14, D15, D17): v13-p07 and v13-p14, run 2.
Alert rules, action intervals and duplicate-trigger rejection (D18-D21): v13-p08 and v13-p15, run 2.
Dashboard stats, integrations, tokens, members and ownership rules (D25): v13-p10, v13-p11 and v13-p16, run 2.
Router registration, wiring and the route-walk inclusion of new routers: v13-p12, run 3; the full v13 leak matrix, E2E, strict screenshots and live checks: v13-p17, run 3.
Deferred product areas: releases, environments, projects, Discover, Jira create, replay, performance and profiling.
